scope: Read-only independent review of the first NV HF implementation and source campaign frontend
consistent_parts: Radial R finite-volume kinetic operator, spherical weights and mixed parity boundary conditions
Distributed tau agrees with the same discrete kinetic-energy quadratic form
Proton spin-current density and radial LS potential use the same angular factor
Density-gradient adjoint is the exact weighted transpose of the chosen discrete gradient
Neutral-cell Coulomb kernel, Slater exchange derivative and electron potential sign
Density/tau/gradient/spin-current scaling exponents in the virial pressure
Frontend process status AND native status guard prevents failed native records from becoming admitted cells

findings.finding: A post-convergence field/dilation validation failure can leave res.converged true; the probe exits zero based solely on that flag even when native status is an error.
findings.requested_fix: Require status == ok and converged for success exit; preserve error status. Frontend currently protects itself separately.
findings.status: fix_present_on_readback; fresh final-contract execution evidence remains with owner

findings.finding: Density-L1 and scalar energy differences do not explicitly verify tau or Jp fixed-point residuals; gradient_residual is initialized to zero but never measured.
findings.requested_fix: Measure appropriate tau/Jp or final-Hamiltonian orbital residuals; keep unused diagnostics undefined rather than claiming a verified zero.
findings.status: fix_present_on_readback; fresh final-contract execution evidence remains with owner

findings.finding: The flag checks whether occupied channels touch the imposed l or radial-state cutoffs. It is a useful sentinel, not an independent convergence proof for omitted channels.
findings.requested_fix: Run an enlarged-basis comparison for representative/high-density cells and phrase the flag consistently with its actual test.

findings.finding: The initial required-key set does not require energy, pressure, or residual diagnostics, allowing a syntactically successful profile with missing critical success fields.
findings.requested_fix: Require the complete native success receipt schema; add malformed/missing-field fixtures.
findings.status: fix_present_on_readback; fresh final-contract execution evidence remains with owner

findings.finding: The all-characters predicate accepts an empty string ID and would write cells/.txt.
findings.status: fix_present_on_readback; fresh final-contract execution evidence remains with owner

findings.finding: Unknown seed_kind silently uses default initialization, and cluster parameters lack explicit finite/range checks.
findings.requested_fix: Validate the seed enumeration and cluster parameter bounds before initialization.
findings.status: fix_present_on_readback; fresh final-contract execution evidence remains with owner

model_conventions_to_record: Open-shell spherical configurations use equal filling of degenerate states
Modern common neutron kinetic mass rather than a claim of literal 1973 numerical constants
The smoothing averaging interval, width cap and particle renormalization are explicit implementation choices beyond the paper's description
Finite composition catalog minima do not establish a global ground-state minimum
